proposal.summary: Authenticated remote code execution in Microweber 1.2.11 via profile image upload of a crafted PHP file, allowing an authenticated admin to upload a PHP7 file to userfiles/media/default/shell.php7.
proposal.cwe_quote:
Change/Add image of profile and Select a Crafted Image file
Crafted image file Aka A image file which craft with PHP CODES for execution

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the upload handling and file-type validation for user profile images; reproduce the upload with admin credentials and attempt to execute the uploaded PHP file. If confirmed, block execution in uploads directory, enforce server-side MIME/type checks, and patch the upload handler to reject executable extensions.

How to trigger: upload crafted image containing PHP code
